    # Build a table view
    all_keys = []
    for row in rows:
        for k in row.keys():
            if k not in all_keys:
                all_keys.append(k)
    # Group by row number
    from collections import OrderedDict
    row_groups = OrderedDict()
    for row in rows:
        for cell_ref, value in row.items():
            # Extract row number
            row_num = ''.join(c for c in cell_ref if c.isdigit())
            col = ''.join(c for c in cell_ref if c.isalpha())
            if row_num not in row_groups:
                row_groups[row_num] = {}
            row_groups[row_num][col] = value

    # Determine columns
    all_cols = []
    for rn, cols in row_groups.items():
        for c in cols:
            if c not in all_cols:
                all_cols.append(c)

    # Build header and rows
    header = "Row\t" + "\t".join(all_cols)
    lines.append(header)
    lines.append("-" * len(header.expandtabs()))
    for rn, cols in row_groups.items():
        vals = [cols.get(c, "") for c in all_cols]
        lines.append(f"{rn}\t" + "\t".join(vals))
    lines.append("")
